_comment: Public-schema object counts a from-zero replay of supabase/migrations/ must produce. Asserted by scripts/rehearse-migrations.sh. When a migration legitimately changes the schema shape, update these numbers in the same commit — editing them without a matching schema change defeats the check.
_source: Measured from a clean replay on 2026-08-06. These are what the migration set BUILDS, which is the thing being asserted. Production is the comparison, not the target.
_prod_delta: Production (uyfnezxmgwitpzsrnkst) does not exactly match this, and the differences are known rather than accidental. Production is MISSING two objects its own migrations create: the compaction_log table and the open_positions view, both from 20260504120000_v2_instrumentation_and_lock.sql, which half-applied and was recorded as successful anyway. Production has one function this branch lacks — settle_memory_attributions, which arrives with the Phase 0 memory-isolation branch and takes functions to 13. Index counts differ because a handful of production indexes carry different names for the same definition (memory_attribution_memory_id_idx vs idx_memory_attribution_memory) and because Phase 0 drops idx_agent_memory_user and adds idx_agent_memory_recall.
_note: Counts exclude extension-owned functions: the shim installs pgcrypto into `extensions`, matching Supabase, so its 36 functions never enter the public count.
